questions.stem: A box of cereal has a gross mass (box + contents) of \(850\text{ g}\). The empty box weighs \(60\text{ g}\). What is the net mass of the cereal alone?
questions.hint: Net mass = gross mass − mass of the container.

steps.explain: Subtract the mass of the empty box from the gross mass.

questions.stem: A geological sample weighs \\(5\\text{ kilograms}\) and \\(637\\text{ grams}\\). Express this weight in kilograms as a decimal.
questions.hint: There are \\(1000\\text{ grams}\) in \\(1\\text{ kilogram}\\). Convert the grams to kilograms by dividing by \\(1000\\), then add it to the kilograms.

steps.explain: Identify the given weights and the conversion relationship between grams and kilograms. We have \\(5\\text{ kg}\) and \\(637\\text{ g}\\), and know that \\(1000\\text{ g} = 1\\text{ kg}\\).
Convert the \\(637\\text{ g}\) to kilograms by dividing by \\(1000\\). This shifts the decimal point three places to the left.
Add the decimal kilograms to the whole kilograms to find the final decimal weight.
Conclude that the sample weight expressed as a decimal is 5.637 kg.

questions.stem: A train departs at \(9{:}45\text{ am}\) and arrives at \(1{:}20\text{ pm}\). How long is the journey?
questions.hint: Find the time from 9:45am to 12:00pm first, then add the remaining time to 1:20pm.

steps.explain: Find the time from 9:45am to 12:00 noon.
Find the time from 12:00pm to 1:20pm.
Add the two parts together.
steps.work: \(2\text{ h }15\text{ min}+1\text{ h }20\text{ min}=3\text{ h }35\text{ min}\)

questions.hint: Subtract 12 from the hour if it is 13 or more.

steps.explain: Since \(15\) is more than \(12\), subtract \(12\) to convert to 12-hour time.
Times after 12:00 noon are labelled "pm".

questions.stem: A bus timetable shows a bus leaving at \(07{:}55\) and the next one leaving \(40\) minutes later. What time (24-hour) does the next bus leave?
questions.hint: Add the minutes, and carry over into the next hour once you reach 60 minutes.

steps.explain: Add 40 minutes to 07:55.
Since 95 minutes is more than 60, convert the extra 60 minutes into 1 hour.
Add this to the hour of 07:00.

questions.stem: An automated delivery drone logs a flight duration of \\(3\\) hours and \\(12\\) minutes. Express this flight duration in decimal hours.
questions.hint: Convert the minutes portion into a fraction of an hour (since there are 60 minutes in an hour) and then convert that fraction to a decimal.

steps.explain: Identify the given hours and minutes. The time is \\(3\\) hours and \\(12\\) minutes, and we need to convert the minutes to decimal hours.
Convert \\(12\\) minutes to a fraction of an hour by dividing by \\(60\\). This is because one hour contains exactly \\(60\\) minutes.
Simplify the fraction by dividing the numerator and denominator by 12. This yields a basic equivalent fraction.
Convert \\(\frac{1}{5}\\) to a decimal by dividing 1 by 5, or multiplying the terms by 2 to get tenths.
Add the decimal hours to the whole hours to find the final answer. The total duration is 3.2 hours.
